author: felicepantaleo
body: These files are copies of the models in cms-data/RecoHGCal-TICL V00-10-00. They do not change. The code that reads them moved to RecoTICL/Inference in cms-sw/cmssw#51919. The commit also replaces the stub README.md with a package README in the form used by cms-data/RecoHGCal-TICL.
title: Add the TICL inference models
